name: Gneiss

facts.text: Level 70, 30,000 health, in Cothrom Gorge. Pieces of Gneiss break off on a timer; pulling it brings six hardened granidons.
Gneiss is the name of a banded metamorphic rock.

story: When the earth split to make Cothrom Gorge, some of the stone that fell into the split did not settle. Gneiss is the largest of it, a hill of banded rock that decided to walk, and the granidons of the gorge, the stone-folk, follow it as if it were their king. Perhaps it is. As it fights, pieces of it crack away and get up on their own, little stones with the same idea. The Sylvan say if you listen at the gorge rim on a still night you can hear it grinding.
legend: Clear the six hardened granidons around it first, or they come with it. Pieces break off it on a timer and fight: kill them as they come. Crush weapons help, the old hands say, and nobody should stand where the falling pieces land.

aggro: The hill moves. The granidons rise with it.

phases.text: A piece of Gneiss cracks away and stands up.

death: The hill settles. It is only stone.

lairEntry: A hill where no hill was yesterday.

phases.text: Pieces of Gneiss break off and attack!
